candidates.title: Desktop Visibility & Control Primer Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated control guide screen right before completing onboarding to explain desktop controls, hotkeys, and desktop pet visibility.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets report post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets, and finish step drops to 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Ready to Meet Your Companion!
home_intro.body: Your pet is live on your desktop. Here is how to toggle visibility and interact whenever you need.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_control_primer']

candidates.title: Spotlight Certificate & Pet Traits Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a spotlight showcase highlighting verified traits and pet preview.
candidates.why: Adoption mean time is 1017s and 3 users reported custom pet rendering issues during setup.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Confirm your pet's official name and traits before bringing them to your desktop environment.

guard.reason: The redesigned adoption certificate fails to include an official stamp.

candidates.title: Move Sign-In Directly Before Desktop Waiting
candidates.change: Reorder sign-in to take place after adoption certificate confirmation and right before the desktop rendering phase.
candidates.why: 8 support emails report pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign-in currently drops 23.1% of users.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion to Your Account
sign_in.body: Sign in now to lock in your adopted pet and preserve your progress across devices.
sign_in.hint: Your adopted pet details will be linked permanently to this account.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in directly addresses the 23.1% drop-off and 8 support emails regarding reset pets.

candidates.title: Desktop Render & Overlay Diagnostic Check Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a desktop renderer diagnostic checklist step during waiting to verify system tray and window overlay compatibility.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pet failing to show on desktop, and home waiting mean time is 2336s.

components.text: We are verifying system overlay and desktop window display permissions.

guard.reason: Diagnostic waiting screen updates maintain the waiting screen's job.

candidates.score_note: New diagnostic flow addresses high wait time and overlay issues, but requires new screens.

candidates.title: Account Protection & Reset Prevention Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in screen headline and hint to clarify that signing in protects existing pet data from being overwritten.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets mention pets missing or reset after signing in, causing drop-off.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet & Account Data
sign_in.body: Log in to guarantee your companion profile is safely synced and backed up.
sign_in.hint: Already adopted a pet? Sign in with your original account to restore it instantly.

guard.reason: Copy update for sign-in is compliant with all base rules.

candidates.score_note: Simple copy fix for high drop-off step (23.1%) strongly backed by 8 support tickets.

candidates.title: Taskbar Desktop Visibility Hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint during waiting stage describing where the pet lives in the system taskbar/menu bar.
candidates.why: 3 support emails report pets not showing up on desktop and users spending a median of 201s waiting.

waiting.hint: Tip: If your pet does not appear on screen immediately, check your desktop taskbar icon to unhide it.

guard.reason: Adding a helpful hint to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost UI hint guiding users where to find the pet during the 201s median wait.

candidates.title: Starter Pet Perk Incentive Banner
candidates.change: Add an incentive badge banner on path selection screen promising a bonus starter accessory upon onboarding completion.
candidates.why: Choose path has an 82.9% conversion rate with long mean time (514s), requiring stronger momentum.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Path & Unlock Starter Perks

guard.reason: Mentions a free extra ('Free Starter Accessory Package') in onboarding copy.

candidates.title: Desktop Spawn Notification Alert
candidates.change: Enable desktop readiness push notifications and progress alerts so users know when generation completes.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a mean of 2336s, causing users to switch windows and miss pet spawn.

waiting.hint: You will get a system notification as soon as your pet arrives on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adding readiness notifications to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Notifications bring back users lost during the long 2336s mean waiting period.

candidates.title: Background Render Diagnostic Checklist Info
candidates.change: Add periodic diagnostic checklist updates on the waiting screen explaining step-by-step rendering progress.
candidates.why: High waiting time variance (median 201s vs mean 2336s) and complaints of missing desktop pets.

guard.reason: Adding diagnostic checklist info to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Diagnostic updates reduce uncertainty for users waiting on home step.

candidates.title: Split Layout Companion Intro Screen
candidates.change: Update story intro screen to a split layout displaying path features side-by-side with companion animations.
candidates.why: Choose path mean completion time is 514s, indicating confusion between custom and preset pet paths.

story.headline: Meet Your New Virtual Companion
story.body: Pick a preset desktop companion or build a completely customized pet from your photos.

guard.reason: Requests personal photos/information from the user
